stories.title: Jensen Huang Expresses Willingness to Return as Nvidia CEO After Resignation
stories.summary: Jensen Huang has stated he would be 'honored' to return as CEO of Nvidia if asked by the board. His comments follow his recent resignation amid reports of personal scandals, including affairs with an employee and a woman linked to Chinese intelligence. Huang's potential reinstatement has garnered significant support, including a petition signed by 190,000 people, many of whom are Nvidia employees.

stories.title: U.S. Loses Measles Elimination Status After 26 Years
stories.summary: The United States has officially lost its measles elimination status for the first time in 26 years, as reported by international health officials. This loss is attributed to a resurgence of measles, primarily among unvaccinated populations, marking the highest transmission rates in over 30 years. The Pan American Health Organization confirmed that the U.S. and Mexico have both lost their measles-free status.

Users have experienced difficulties accessing these services, and while Apple is working to restore functionality, some issues persist as of Tuesday.

stories.title: Ukraine Launches Major Attack on Kerch Bridge Linking Crimea to Russia
stories.summary: Ukraine has executed a significant missile and drone attack on the Kerch Bridge, which connects Russia to the annexed Crimea. This operation, described by President Volodymyr Zelensky as unprecedented, was reportedly planned over several weeks and marks the second consecutive night of strikes on the bridge. The attack has caused substantial damage to the structure, which is a critical link for Russia.

stories.title: Iran Denies Allegations of Planning 'Dirty Bomb' Attack on Washington
stories.summary: Iran has dismissed claims that it is plotting a 'dirty bomb' attack on Washington, labeling the reports as baseless. U.S. officials are reportedly debating the credibility of these allegations, while Trump stated that his administration is taking the threat seriously, despite the White House asserting there are currently no credible threats. Trump has issued a warning to Iran regarding these allegations.

stories.title: Jensen Huang to Testify Before Congress on Nvidia's National Security Concerns
stories.summary: Jensen Huang, former CEO of Nvidia, has agreed to testify before several congressional committees on December 1 regarding the company's sales to China and potential national security risks. This hearing follows his resignation amid allegations of an affair with a suspected Chinese intelligence asset. Nvidia has also established a national security committee in response to these issues.

stories.title: UK Imposes Sanctions on Israeli Firms Over West Bank Settlements
stories.summary: The UK government has announced sanctions against eight Israeli construction companies involved in building illegal settlements in the West Bank. This decision aims to hinder further settlement expansion, which the UK Foreign Office states undermines the prospects for a two-state solution. The sanctions also target a right-wing Israeli activist group linked to blocking aid efforts.
